pulse.description: 1–2 short sentences describing the overall market environment, primarily derived from core_data.summary.

summary.description: One concise sentence: what happened and why it matters to the market.

highlights.description: Same count and order as core_data.highlights (max 3). Do not add or remove entries.

label.description: Asset, index, rate, commodity, or market identifier.

value.description: Explicitly supported value when useful; null otherwise.

direction.description: Direction supported by source data only.

market_reaction.description: Up to 3 observable market reactions from core_data.items; may be empty.

takeaway.description: Exactly one sentence expressing the key market relationship or implication, primarily derived from core_data.ending.
